text:
### Observed differences

- A group of five activities — A19, A20, A25, A26, A27 — now runs much earlier in the case: their mean event position was about 0.60–0.64 of the trace in the earlier window and is about 0.34–0.36 in the later window, while their participation stayed similar (each in roughly 17–24 in 100 traces in both windows). [POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005]
- Their order relative to A28 and A29 reversed. Earlier, in the roughly 20–24 in 100 cases where a group member co-occurred with A28 or A29, A28/A29 always came first; in the later window the group member comes first in about 18–22 in 100 cases, and A28/A29 first in at most about 0.5 in 100. [REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006]
- The group's successors changed almost completely. Earlier, the outgoing transitions of each group member split between A34 (about 38–58 in 100) and A30 (about 42–57 in 100); in the later window about 93–100 in 100 of them lead to A28. [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005]
- The region after A29 lost its detour through the group. Earlier, A29 sent about 48 in 100 of its transitions to a group member (about 51 in 100 to A30), and A30 sent about 51 in 100 back into the group (about 48 in 100 to A34); in the later window A29 leads to A30 in about 98–99 in 100 transitions and A30 leads to A34 in about 98–99 in 100, so A29 reaches A34 typically two steps later instead of three. [DIR006, DIR007, LAG006, LAG007, LAG008]
- A47 now routes through the group: earlier about 91 in 100 of its outgoing transitions went directly to A28; in the later window about 92 in 100 go to one of the five group members (each about 17–20 in 100), and the A47→A28 distance changed from immediate (one step, about 92 in 100) to two steps (about 92 in 100). A20 is now followed immediately by A28 in about 38 cases, where this pair barely appeared before. [DIR008, LAG009, LAG002]
- The old edges from group members to A34 and from A29 into the group have nearly disappeared, each remaining observable in only about 1 case in the later window. [LAG001, LAG003, LAG004, LAG005]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

One plausible reading, directly supported by the relational, positional and routing evidence, is that the block of activities A19, A20, A25, A26, A27 was repositioned to an earlier stage of the process. In the earlier window the block ran after A29 and was intertwined with A30 (A29 and A30 each sent about half of their transitions into it, and block members exited to A30 or A34); in the later window the block sits between A47 and A28 — A47 selects one of the five, and each of the five leads almost always to A28 — while the remaining path runs directly A29 → A30 → A34. The DIR, POS, REL and LAG items here describe one underlying pattern rather than independent confirmations: the order flip against A28/A29, the position shift from about 0.62 to about 0.35, the successor changes on both sides, and the step-distance changes all show the same relocation. With 30 qualifying control-flow items against roughly 0.61 expected if nothing had changed (each item also larger than in about 995 of 1000 random re-splits), a chance origin of the overall pattern is implausible. Limitation: traces cannot distinguish a genuine relocation of the block from the old usage being dropped while the same activities are newly invoked after A47, and a few near-disappeared edges rest on single observations. [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, LAG001, LAG002, LAG003, LAG004, LAG005, LAG006, LAG007, LAG008, LAG009]

Other differences: A27's participation dipped from about 24 in 100 traces to about 18–19 in 100 [POS005, DIR005]; A28 and A29 each shifted slightly later in the trace (mean position about 0.36 → 0.38 and about 0.58 → 0.60) [POS006, POS007]; and a few rare new successors appeared, such as A19 → A07/A31 and A30 → A21, each at about 0.5–2 in 100 transitions [DIR001, DIR007]. A competing explanation the evidence cannot rule out is that the early occurrence of the five activities is a new, separately inserted use of them rather than a move of the original block, since both would leave identical traces.
